head: af6868e5703bf21f9d57ed1fda37a50369fbb781
decision: Replace the unsafe in-place internal Restore API with explicit restore into a new persistent destination. Repository-wide call inspection found only tests. Full recovery must fence old writers and adopt the replacement through the deployment coordinator.
changes: Backup returns format, exact byte count, and SHA-256 identity for the coordinated manifest. It creates a private file exclusively and flushes data and parent metadata.
Restore copies and hashes the declared artifact into private staging before loading it. Framing checks reject lengths outside the verified payload before Badger allocates them.
Load uses a private candidate and preserves absolute expirations and engine configuration. Publication refuses every existing destination.
Flush candidate files before native no-replacement publication, then flush the parent. Report publication separately from a later durability error.
The original store remains open and unchanged. No hot database pointer replacement occurs.

checks.broader_source: Before final format-tag and load-helper extraction. Final focused checks cover all changed restore behavior.
checks.lint: PASS: full make lint, zero issues
checks.writing: PASS: both new files, zero diagnostics

candidate_failures: Initial fixture paths did not satisfy owner-only private-file policy. Tests now create private directories through the native product-file API.
Concurrent publication returned wrapped EEXIST. The test now checks error identity with errors.Is rather than legacy os.IsExist.
limits: Local macOS component evidence only. Native Linux and Windows qualification remains required.
Backup covers Badger alone. SQL, blobs, runtime files, configuration, keys, and independent recovery evidence require the coordinated manifest.
Corrupt and mismatched input refuses publication. Interrupted-process recovery and orphan-stage ownership remain part of the complete operator procedure.
The caller must verify the externally retained backup identity. This component does not establish revocation or spending freshness.
CSP13 remains in_progress. Required review, final task checks, native CI, and merge remain open.
publication: Local commit only. No CSP13 PR or push.
